resources.string_add: How the actions in this menu show their counts, on the site and in the apps. Labels: each action shows its name, and a stats menu can show the counts. Counts: each action shows its count in place of its name, and its icon alone while the count is 0. Button groups: each action is two joined buttons, the action and its count, which shows who did it. Automatic uses the menu's own choice.
